Sub Delete_rows()
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Dim sh1 As Worksheet
    Dim lastrow As Long
    Set sh1 = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Delete")
    lastrow = sh1.Cells(Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
    With sh1
        .AutoFilterMode = False
        .Range("A1:B" & lastrow).AutoFilter Field:=2, Criteria1:=Array("STATIONERY", "VEGETABLES"), Operator:=xlFilterValues
        .Range("A2:B" & lastrow).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible).EntireRow.Delete
        .AutoFilterMode = False
    End With
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
End Sub
